definitions.ask: Should sase_blog's ^prj also require the post to be announced?

choices.label: ^prj reads "My SASE post, in my own voice, is live on https://sase.sh!"
^prj adds "and announced"; the project stays open until you announce the post

definitions.why: Not already true (the July draft is live) and neutral on the open goodbye framing

definitions.ask: Should job_2026's "Release [[sase_blog]] post!" task (^sase-blog) move into sase_blog?

choices.label: Moves into sase_blog with its job_2026_apply_29 dependency; leaves the job-search view
Stays in job_2026, so the release step keeps showing in the job-search view

definitions.why: ADJ-5 gives the finish line one owner, as "manage everything from sase_blog" asks

definitions.ask: Should the ^zk task ("Launch agent to create ~/bob/zk/ notes") be cancelled rather than rewritten?

choices.label: Cancelled with a Cancel Log reason; it lands in Done & Canceled
Stays Blocked until 10-17; its zettel bullet says ordinary notes, not project notes

definitions.why: Rolled since 08-25, its sibling was cancelled as a duplicate, and it over-structures

definitions.ask: Should the Databricks job-fit ref be refiled under job_2026?

choices.label: Its archived task moves to a new done/job_2026_done.md, so its parent stays job_2026
Stays in the renamed blog archive; its parent becomes [[sase_blog]]

definitions.why: ADJ-8 wants job_2026; a ref's parent follows its task's archive, so only a refile sticks

definitions.ask: Should sase_post_blog be gated on the post again?

choices.label: No change; sase_post_blog's open tasks stay Ready
Its ^prj depends on sase_blog#^prj; every open task, its bug fix too, waits for the post

definitions.why: ADJ-7 keeps it separate; a gate would also park its "Fix remote machines!" task
